purpose: Benchmark the user-approved BF16 Windows shared-memory training path on the existing desktop. Preserve the original failed resident-VRAM gate.

runtime.platform: Existing Windows desktop through WSL2 Ubuntu-24.04, RTX 4060 Ti 8188 MiB dedicated VRAM, 32 GB host physical RAM
runtime.triton_decision: Keep the existing torch-locked Triton 3.4.0. FLA core CUDA metadata requires >=3.3. Ada compatibility is unproven until the registered correctness check passes; do not copy the Modal Hopper-specific override or silently upgrade.
runtime.isolation: Use the existing primary WSL Python with a fresh external --target overlay prepended to PYTHONPATH. Never install into, recreate, or sync the primary .venv. No worktree .venv is created.
runtime.acquisition: Verify downloaded wheel SHA-256 and embedded METADATA before installing with --no-deps into the external overlay. Record actual imported package file paths and versions, Python ABI, torch CUDA build and CXX11 ABI. A mismatch or new undeclared dependency stops preflight; no automatic resolver upgrades.
runtime.kernels: Transformers optional training-capable causal_conv1d_fn and fla.ops.gated_delta_rule.chunk_gated_delta_rule only. Assert canonical kernel_environment names actual package implementations rather than reference fallbacks.

recipe.lora_targets: all, checked by canonical strict warm_start coverage against the locked parent
recipe.question: Use registration.json record instructions verbatim
recipe.fixture: Recreate and verify the original neutral hardware fixture. One unique row repeated 32 times, not a corpus or detector-quality evaluation.

limits.wall_scope: One monotonic deadline begins before the first GPU inventory/correctness process. Includes all CUDA initialization, kernel JIT/autotuning, correctness, model loading, 32 microbatches, optimizer updates, checkpoint save and reload. CPU-only wheel acquisition/overlay preparation occurs before this deadline and has a separate elapsed record.
limits.enforcement: External CPU-only watchdog owns the wall deadline and native Windows counters; the measured child exports allocator observations without adding another CUDA context. Missing critical monitoring for 3 consecutive samples stops as monitoring_failure. A memory breach triggers SIGINT only to the verified benchmark process group, then SIGTERM after 30 seconds, SIGKILL after a further 30 seconds if needed; retain actual signal/exit and evidence. At the 2700-second hard deadline terminate the benchmark process group immediately and reap it. Never signal unrelated Phase 2, GUI, or service processes.
limits.no_configuration_changes: Do not change driver fallback policy, WSL memory/swap settings, applications, CUDA allocator settings, or the registered model/precision/context. Shared GPU system memory is permitted only by the recorded amendment.

kernel_correctness.execution: Separate short-lived subprocess on the same exclusive GPU lease, before loading the full model; no correctness CUDA context remains during training.
kernel_correctness.inputs: Deterministic BF16 query/key/value and convolution inputs; bounded negative decay g and sigmoid beta using the canonical Qwen convention. Independent cloned leaf inputs for reference and optimized paths and the same random upstream gradient. No cache and no final recurrent state; QK L2 normalization enabled.
kernel_correctness.reference: Call the installed Transformers 5.17 original undecorated reference functions via inspect.unwrap, verify their source identity, and compare to the explicit optional-package implementations. No inference-only Kev fused path.
kernel_correctness.outputs: All finite; torch.testing.assert_close atol=0.01, rtol=0.02 for BF16 forward outputs.
kernel_correctness.gradients: Actually backpropagate through both operators; require all expected input gradients present and finite and nonzero norm for exercised differentiable inputs. Compare all input gradients, and convolution weight/bias gradients when supplied, with torch.testing.assert_close atol=0.02, rtol=0.05. Report max-absolute and RMS error as well. Never loosen thresholds after observing a failure.
kernel_correctness.failure: A correctness failure or unsupported compilation stops the arm before full-model training; report dependency/kernel_correctness_failure separately from memory/time failure. No automatic alternate Triton/precision/shape attempt.

required: strict parent adapter and head warm start
actual BF16 frozen backbone and FP32 trainable parameters
two completed AdamW updates and 32 microbatches
at least one changed adapter tensor and one changed head tensor
fresh-process unmerged BF16 reload with matching TF32 flags and exact pre-save/reload logits
all registered resource and time bounds respected
success_contract.incomplete: Any missing proof, limit breach, monitoring failure, timeout, numerical failure or process failure is failed/incomplete feasibility, never a pass. Distinguish functional execution from the amended memory contract and the historical resident-VRAM gate.
success_contract.scope: A pass establishes only bounded local feasibility under Windows shared memory, not resident-VRAM fit, full-study reliability, detector accuracy, or permission to bypass Phase 2/3/5 gates.

measure: cold kernel compilation and validation elapsed
cold model load and warm start
native Windows adapter and VM shared counters with attribution limits
stop reason and exact terminal stage
reporting.projection: Report 6000-record collection target times 6 search epochs plus 2 or 4 confirmation epochs, hence 48000 or 60000 record passes, divided by observed throughput. State all rows here have maximum registered length; actual corpus mix is not frozen. Separate observed compile/load/save overhead and unknown evaluation/labeling overhead. Two steps give a point projection without a defensible long-run uncertainty interval; report per-step variation and this limitation.
reporting.historical_files: Verify original phase-4 model lock, raw reports, failed gate, handoff and amendment hashes before and after. Do not edit them.
reporting.outputs: Fresh ignored runs/judge-manipulation-phase4-shared/<unique-run-id>/ and fresh experiments/judge-manipulation/shared-memory-reports/<unique-run-id>/. Refuse existing paths. Runtime and retained reports identify this plan hash and never overwrite earlier evidence.

coordination: Root must review this plan and implementation and grant a clean exclusive GPU lease after Phase 2 releases its model. No GPU work, primary-environment mutation, driver/settings changes or Git mutations by the implementation worker before that handoff.
